entries.6753021daaa34d4d: This business is run by Nisshō Interlife Co., Ltd. The business covers planning, design, engineering, production and construction management for commercial facilities (restaurants and retail stores), hotels and bridal facilities, offices, and exhibitions, and also includes contract cleaning of building interiors and exteriors and maintenance of air-conditioning and other equipment. In June 2025, the company absorbed Facility Management Co., Ltd. through an absorption merger, and that company's business has been taken over as the FM Business Division. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥10,046 million.

entries.8d63f8fedc1badb7: The group's strength lies in its structure, which allows it to take orders on a consistent basis for everything from planning, design, engineering, production and construction management of commercial facilities and the like, to cleaning contracts inside and outside buildings and maintenance of air-conditioning equipment and other systems. Following the absorption merger in June 2025, Nisshō Interlife Co., Ltd. has become able to take orders on a consistent basis, through to cleaning and maintenance work for commercial facilities it builds itself. In addition, Nisshō Interlife Co., Ltd. has jointly developed with Yamada Danboru Co., Ltd. the 'Atorasu Bōdo', an energy-saving and environmental protection material using a patented hybrid board of recycled paper and aluminum foil, and is advancing its development and construction.
